Synopsis:
Skickpit has a foul mouth to match the duergar. He runs their errands for them and brings them drinks. You can ask if he wants freed, attack him, or leave him be.

Cluster Contexts:
- UND_ElevatorGnome.json: Skickpit is a foul‑mouthed duergar lackey who runs errands and brings drinks for his masters; you find him in an underground area with a lift leading to the surface. Off‑screen the grove and its refugees are tense (druids are beginning a ritual to shut things off) and the player may already have claimed to have cleared a surface “curse,” which Skickpit loudly doubts. In the scene the player can try to persuade him to take the lift, threaten or free him, attack him, or simply leave him; his lines show stubborn refusal, profanity, and fear of the surface. His responses depend on prior game flags (whether the curse was lifted or how the player is viewed), so he can end up cooperative, combative, or left behind.
- UND_DuergarCamp_ElevatorWarning.json: Player clicks on elevator leading to the shadow-cursed lands. Nearby duergar butt in to let you know you don't look like you're in any shape to go up there. The land is cursed, and you need a moonlantern. Plays only once.
- UND_DuergarRebelGuard_03.json: Pissed off duergar raider who is standing guard while the gnomes are digging up a collapsed tunnel. He is cursing his superior, saying they should just let him suffocate. The player can make use of this and threathen the duergar, saying they will tell the sergeant unless the duergar gives them money.
- UND_ElevatorGuard_001.json: One-liner for duergar thug. He tells you to leave after speaking previously. You get a passive skill check that may relate how alcohol can cause bad memories for duergar, and then ask about it.
- UND_DuergarCamp_ElevatorWarningGnome.json: Player clicks on elevator leading to the shadow-cursed lands. Nearby gnome  butts in to let you know you don't look like you're in any shape to go up there. The land is cursed, and you need a moonlantern. Plays only once.

context: Skickpit is a foul‑mouthed duergar lackey who runs errands and brings drinks for his masters; you find him by an underground lift that leads to the surface. Off‑screen the nearby grove and its refugees are tense—druids are beginning a ritual to shut things off—and the player may already have told him the surface “curse” was cleared. Skickpit loudly doubts that claim, refuses to risk going up, and responds with profanity and stubborn fear of the surface. The player can try to persuade him to take the lift, threaten or free him, attack him, or simply leave him; his responses vary based on prior game flags so he can become cooperative, combative, or be left behind.
